name: Confidentiality Notice and Version Control
summary: Check that the deliverable contains a confidentiality notice, a version number, a current date, and a change log or version history
purpose: Check that the deliverable contains a confidentiality notice, a version number, a current date, and a change log or version history. These are required legal and compliance elements for client-facing documents.
assignment_instructions:
You are a client deliverable readiness evaluator. Inspect the provided deliverable document for the following required elements:
1. CONFIDENTIALITY NOTICE: A notice stating the document is confidential,
   proprietary, or intended for specific recipients only. Check:
   - present (boolean)
   - location (string: page number or section)
   - text (string: exact or approximate text found)
   - classification_level (string: "Confidential", "Proprietary",
     "Internal Use Only", "Restricted", or "Not Specified")

2. VERSION NUMBER: A version identifier for this document. Check:
   - present (boolean)
   - version_string (string: the version text found, e.g., "v2.3")
   - location (string: where it appears)

3. DOCUMENT DATE: The date associated with this version of the document. Check:
   - present (boolean)
   - date_string (string: the date text found)
   - date_parsed (string: ISO-8601 date if parseable, else "unparseable")
   - is_current (boolean: true if the date is within 30 days of today,
     false otherwise; if today's date is unavailable, set to "unknown")
   - location (string: where it appears)

4. CHANGE LOG / VERSION HISTORY: A record of changes across versions. Check:
   - present (boolean)
   - entry_count (integer: number of entries found, 0 if absent)
   - location (string: where it appears)
   - latest_entry (string: text of the most recent entry, "" if absent)

Return a single JSON object with this exact structure: {
  "assignment_id": "client_confidentiality_version_v1",
  "agent_summary": "<one-sentence summary>",
  "inputs_used": ["<list inputs>"],
  "missing_inputs": ["<list missing inputs>"],
  "claims": [
    {
      "claim": "<specific claim>",
      "evidence_reference": "<page/section reference>",
      "confidence": "provided | inferred | missing"
    }
  ],
  "confidentiality_notice": {
    "present": true,
    "location": "",
    "text": "",
    "classification_level": ""
  },
  "version_control": {
    "present": true,
    "version_string": "",
    "location": ""
  },
  "document_date": {
    "present": true,
    "date_string": "",
    "date_parsed": "",
    "is_current": true,
    "location": ""
  },
  "change_log": {
    "present": true,
    "entry_count": 0,
    "location": "",
    "latest_entry": ""
  },
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk": "<risk description>",
      "severity": "low | medium | high",
      "evidence_reference": ""
    }
  ],
  "assumptions": ["<assumptions>"],
  "open_questions": ["<open questions>"],
  "final_output": "<PASS, CONDITIONAL_PASS, or FAIL>",
  "self_check": {
    "all_required_sections_completed": true,
    "all_numbers_have_sources": true,
    "assumptions_labeled": true,
    "missing_inputs_disclosed": true
  }
}
Rules for final_output: - "PASS": All four elements (confidentiality_notice, version_control,
  document_date, change_log) are present and the document date is current.
- "CONDITIONAL_PASS": All elements are present but the date is older than
  30 days, or the change log has fewer than 2 entries.
- "FAIL": Any of confidentiality_notice, version_control, or document_date
  is missing. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.

audit_checks.label: Confidentiality notice is missing - this is a legal/compliance risk
Version number is missing - clients cannot track document revisions
Document date is missing - prevents currency verification
Document date is older than 30 days - may indicate outdated deliverable
Change log is missing - reduces transparency for the client
Agent did not complete all required self-check sections
